munis.name: Milwaukee city (Milwaukee County)
munis.x_basis: assumed ramp from Milwaukee's observed pre-reform candidate rate to a Madison-like level (by right, no parking, owner occupancy only at application) since 2025-08-02
munis.rights_added_text: Removes owner-occupancy-at-application rule; otherwise already by right (detached up to 1,300 sq ft, no parking).

munis.name: Madison city
munis.rights_added_text: None on most single-family parcels. Edge cases only: (1) the reform extends ADUs to single-family parcels in districts where ADUs are not listed (e.g. LMX, MXC, CC, RMX, THV, downtown/urban and employment districts with houses, PD); (2) it removes replacement parking: outside the TOD overlay and the no-minimum districts the principal house keeps its own 1-space minimum (Table 28I-3), so a garage conversion that removes the only space needs a replacement space.

munis.name: Green Bay city
munis.rights_added_text: ADUs by right instead of conditional use; removes ongoing owner-occupancy rule; removes 1 required parking space.

munis.name: Kenosha city
munis.rights_added_text: Detached and attached ADUs by right in all single-family districts for any occupant; removes the domestic-help occupant limit and the one-principal-building bar; at least 600 sq ft despite the 840 sq ft / 15% accessory cap; no extra parking.

munis.name: Racine city
munis.rights_added_text: One detached or attached ADU by right on every R1/R2 single-family lot; at least 600 sq ft; no extra parking; no owner-occupancy or relative rule.

munis.name: Janesville city
munis.rights_added_text: ADUs by right (detached and attached, at least 600 sq ft, no extra parking, no owner occupancy) in all single-family districts.

munis.name: Appleton city (Outagamie County)
munis.x_basis: benchmark group rate, ramping from prohibited since 2021-07-13
munis.rights_added_text: Guarantees at least 600 sq ft for an attached ADU regardless of house size and attached garage (lifts the 35%-of-house attached-accessory cap); otherwise already benchmark (ADU plus junior ADU by right, no parking, no owner occupancy).

munis.name: Eau Claire city (Eau Claire County)
munis.rights_added_text: Removes 1 required parking space per ADU; administrative limited-use permit becomes a plain zoning permit.

munis.name: Oshkosh city
munis.x_basis: restricted group rate, ramping from prohibited since 2023-02-28
munis.rights_added_text: Raises the 400 sq ft ADU cap so at least 600 sq ft is allowed.

munis.name: Waukesha city
munis.x_basis: restricted group rate, ramping from prohibited since 2026-09-01
munis.rights_added_text: Removes 1 required parking space per ADU; guarantees a 600 sq ft ADU regardless of house size (attached cap 40% of the house; detached 75%).

munis.name: West Allis city
munis.x_basis: restricted group rate, ramping from prohibited since 2022-05-03
munis.rights_added_text: Guarantees a 600 sq ft ADU regardless of house size (removes 50%-of-principal footprint cap); allows attached/internal ADUs by right in RA-1/RA-2.

munis.name: Wauwatosa city
munis.rights_added_text: None beyond current code on most parcels. Edge cases only: houses under 600 sq ft (cap = house size), and replacement parking: the principal house's 1 required space must be maintained or replaced on-site (§24.10.075(B)(7)), which the reform's no-additional-parking rule would remove for garage conversions.

munis.name: Sheboygan city
munis.rights_added_text: Detached and attached ADUs by right where none are allowed.

munis.name: Brookfield city
munis.rights_added_text: One ADU (separate dwelling with kitchen) per single-family parcel, detached and attached, by right in R-1 to R-3; at least 600 sq ft; no extra parking; no owner-occupancy or related-occupant rule.

munis.name: New Berlin city
munis.rights_added_text: Detached and semi-detached ADUs; at least 600 sq ft (50%-of-house cap); ADUs outside agricultural/single-family districts; removes owner-occupancy, related-occupant and 2-occupant rules; no extra parking.

munis.name: Fond du Lac city
munis.x_basis: restricted group rate, ramping from prohibited since 2025-02-26
munis.rights_added_text: Removes ongoing owner-occupancy rule; removes 1 extra parking space; lifts footprint cap for small houses.

munis.name: Wausau city
munis.rights_added_text: Detached and attached ADUs by right (not conditional use) in all single-family districts incl. DR-6; removes owner-occupancy; at least 600 sq ft always allowed (800 sq ft / 75% cap).

munis.name: La Crosse city
munis.x_basis: restricted group rate, ramping from prohibited since 2024-02-17
munis.rights_added_text: Attached/internal ADUs by right; removes ongoing owner-occupancy rule and deed restriction.

munis.name: Menomonee Falls village
munis.rights_added_text: One ADU per single-family parcel, detached and attached, by right in R-1 to R-6/CDD/PRD; at least 600 sq ft; no extra parking; no owner/related rule.

munis.name: Beloit city
munis.rights_added_text: Rentable ADUs by right on every single-family parcel, detached and attached; removes guest/employee no-rent limit and 12,000 sq ft lot minimum; exempts ADUs from the 1,000 sq ft minimum dwelling size and the single-to-multi conversion ban.

munis.name: Manitowoc city
munis.rights_added_text: Detached and attached ADUs by right where none are allowed.

munis.name: Franklin city
munis.x_basis: restricted group rate, ramping from prohibited since 2025-06-09
munis.rights_added_text: Detached and attached ADUs by right in all residential districts (currently conditional use); removes owner primary-residence requirement.

munis.name: Oak Creek city
munis.rights_added_text: ADUs by right (currently conditional use) in all single-family districts incl. ER/Rs-5/Rd-1; standalone detached ADUs (currently only above/within an existing garage); removes owner-occupancy; at least 600 sq ft always allowed; removes extra ADU parking.

munis.name: Caledonia village
munis.rights_added_text: Detached and attached ADUs by right on single-family lots (none now; a pending draft would be conditional use only).

munis.name: Neenah city
munis.rights_added_text: Detached and attached ADUs by right where none are allowed.

munis.name: Muskego city
munis.rights_added_text: Detached ADUs by right (currently conditional, employee/relative only, no rental, 1,200 sq ft minimum); attached/internal ADUs by right without Plan Commission review; removes related-occupant and no-rental restrictions.

munis.name: Sun Prairie city
munis.x_basis: restricted group rate, ramping from its observed prohibited-period rate since 2026-05-08
munis.rights_added_text: Extends ADUs to single-family parcels in the RH-35ac, CR-5ac and ER-1 districts (now excluded); approval is already ministerial (special use reviewed by staff, no hearing) and needs no extra parking.

munis.name: Greenfield city
munis.rights_added_text: One ADU per single-family parcel, detached and attached, by right in R-1 to R-4B; at least 600 sq ft; no extra parking; no owner-occupancy or related-occupant rule.

munis.name: Superior city
munis.rights_added_text: Detached and attached ADUs by right on single-family parcels where none are allowed.

munis.name: Mount Pleasant village
munis.rights_added_text: Guarantees at least 600 sq ft regardless of house size (replaces 40% cap); removes the suite one-rental-unit rule; confirms no extra parking for cottages.

munis.name: West Bend city
munis.rights_added_text: One ADU per single-family parcel, detached and attached, by right, at least 600 sq ft, no extra parking, no owner/related rule (overrides one-principal-structure rule and 720 sq ft accessory cap).

munis.name: Mequon city
munis.rights_added_text: Detached ADUs; attached ADUs by right instead of conditional use in all single-family districts incl. R-5; removes ongoing owner-occupancy and family/caretaker-only occupancy; at least 600 sq ft (40% cap); confirms no extra parking.

munis.name: De Pere city
munis.rights_added_text: Removes ongoing owner-occupancy/deed-restriction rule; lifts the 30%-of-house cap on internal suites.

munis.name: Pleasant Prairie village
munis.rights_added_text: Detached and attached ADUs by right in all single-family districts (R-1 to R-6, R-4.5, A-2); repeals the §420-30B dwelling ban for accessory structures.

munis.name: Fitchburg city
munis.rights_added_text: Guarantees 600 sq ft where the 75%-of-house cap binds (houses under 800 sq ft) and confirms no parking minimum; otherwise already benchmark.

munis.name: Stevens Point city
munis.rights_added_text: ADUs by right (not conditional use); allows attached/internal ADUs; removes owner-occupancy; removes 1 parking space; removes the single-family-minimum / 10,000 sq ft R-3 lot requirement.

munis.name: Howard village (Brown County)
munis.rights_added_text: Detached and attached ADUs by right; repeals the §50-868 living-space ban in accessory buildings.

munis.name: Appleton city (Calumet County)
munis.x_basis: benchmark group rate, ramping from prohibited since 2021-07-13
munis.rights_added_text: Guarantees at least 600 sq ft for an attached ADU regardless of house size and attached garage (lifts the 35%-of-house attached-accessory cap); otherwise already benchmark (ADU plus junior ADU by right, no parking, no owner occupancy).

munis.name: Eau Claire city (Chippewa County)
munis.rights_added_text: Removes 1 required parking space per ADU; administrative limited-use permit becomes a plain zoning permit.

munis.name: Appleton city (Winnebago County)
munis.x_basis: benchmark group rate, ramping from prohibited since 2021-07-13
munis.rights_added_text: Guarantees at least 600 sq ft for an attached ADU regardless of house size and attached garage (lifts the 35%-of-house attached-accessory cap); otherwise already benchmark (ADU plus junior ADU by right, no parking, no owner occupancy).
